items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: sex-crazed negro, sex-drugged crazed negro attacks detective, Samuel Green, age seven, alleged to have stolen a couple of bananas.

ctx.x: Under strain all the time/ because you see, what happens is, he's under the strain, I mean, mentally -- I mean, if he's a musician of color.
He's sensitive in ear and he's sensitive of many things and he's hearing all of these racial things and he knows that that's what's happening. Everyday.
